metadata.note: Q1b(i) is 9m table-completion (not auto-gradeable — requires burette reading images). Q1b(ii) (1m): identify concordant titrations. Q1b(iii) (1m): calculate average. Burette data: T1(rough)=25.0cm³, T2=25.0cm³, T3=25.0cm³. Concordant = T2 and T3 (T1 excluded as rough). Average = (25.0+25.0)/2 = 25.0cm³. Combined into one file.

question.name: CSEC Chem Jan 2023 Q1b(ii/iii) — Concordant Titrations and Average Volume
question.text:
The titration results for the reaction of sodium hydroxide with sulfuric acid are shown below:

Burette Reading / cm³Titration 1 (Rough)Titration 2Titration 3
Final reading25.537.240.5
Initial reading0.512.215.5
Volume of acid used / cm³25.025.025.0

(ii) Indicate the titration volumes that will be used to calculate the average volume of sulfuric acid. (1 mark)

(iii) Calculate the average volume of sulfuric acid used in the titration. (1 mark)
question.general_feedback:
Q1b(ii) — Concordant titrations:

Titration 1 is the rough titration — it is always excluded from the average, regardless of its value, because it is used only to find the approximate end point.

The concordant titrations are Titration 2 and Titration 3 (both give 25.0 cm³ — they agree to within 0.1 cm³, so they are concordant).

Q1b(iii) — Average volume:

Average = (25.0 + 25.0) ÷ 2 = 25.0 cm³

Rule: Concordant titres agree within 0.1 cm³ of each other. If T2 and T3 differ by more than 0.1 cm³, a T4 would be needed.

steps.label:
Titration data: T1 (Rough) = 25.0 cm³ | T2 = 25.0 cm³ | T3 = 25.0 cm³
Rule: T1 is always excluded (rough titration). Concordant = T2 and T3 (agree within 0.1 cm³).
Calculate the average volume of sulfuric acid used. (1 mark)

fields.label: Concordant titrations used: _____
fields.diagnostic_hint: Titration 1 is the rough titration and is always excluded. Titrations 2 and 3 both give 25.0 cm³ — they are concordant.

error_codes.SC_METHOD_ERROR: In a titration, the first run (Titration 1) is a rough titration used only to find the approximate endpoint — it is always excluded when calculating the average, even if its volume matches the others. Concordant titrations are Titration 2 and Titration 3.

fields.label: Average volume of sulfuric acid = _____ cm³

error_codes.SC_CALCULATION_ERROR: Add the two concordant titration volumes (T2 + T3 = 25.0 + 25.0 = 50.0 cm³) and divide by 2 to get the average: 50.0 ÷ 2 = 25.0 cm³.
error_codes.SC_METHOD_ERROR: Do not include the rough titration (T1) in the average. Use only the concordant titres: T2 = 25.0 cm³ and T3 = 25.0 cm³.
